title: 卷一江湖少年 第十一章东窗事发卷一江湖少年 第十二章长刀之柄
slug: 梦启东梁第一四零六章蛛丝有毒

东窗事发
随着吴威住进长刀门，整个平川城的人都知道，长刀门与五音亭的这桩婚事已经是板上钉钉的事情了。
就在吴威抵达的第二天，原本还在观望的一些人家纷纷向长刀门送出了贺礼，就连城主府也派人送来了贺信，这让赵如安愈发觉得满意了。
很快，时间来到了婚期前的第二天，按照原定的计划，五音亭李长老将会携二弟子前来，同时作为长辈出席婚礼。
这天一早，赵如安便和吴威一起到城门外等候了，虽然早有探马来报说李长老一行最早会在正午时分抵达，但赵如安为了显示诚意，一大早便命人做好了迎接的准备，而作为大弟子的吴威对此当然没有意见。
城外凉亭中，随着探马一波波来报，赵如安脸上的笑意就没有停下来过。
再有两天，他们长刀门就会成为平川城内首屈一指的势力，赵如安有信心在十年之内让长刀门的名头传遍整个东海郡。
“门主，李长老一行已经抵达十里外。
又有一批探马来报，赵如安闻言面上的笑意更甚。
“贤侄，李长老行动如此迅捷，想来也是一路快马加鞭而来啊！
“赵如安看向一旁的吴威，微微笑道。
吴威闻言眼中却是闪过一抹疑惑，似有些不解。
不过间赵如安正看向自己，吴威还是抱拳道，“二十妹平常最得师傅宠爱，这次师妹大婚，师傅亦是非常看重，想来师傅也是怕出现什么闪失，是以这才快马加鞭的赶来了。
“哈哈，“赵如安闻言爽朗的笑了起来，”
快一些也好，我早已经命人备下了佳酿，就等李长老的大驾光临了。
笑声传出，赵如安回身坐在凉亭内的石桌前，端起桌上的茶水饮了一口。
“康儿，“赵如安看向一旁等候的赵康，”
你替我带人前去迎一下李长老。
是，父亲。

“赵康闻言抱拳离去。
一旁的吴威目送着赵康一行远去的背影，不知为何，心中总感觉哪里有些不对。
“贤侄，过来喝茶。
赵如安见吴威一直站在那里，遂抬手招呼道。
吴威闻言点了点头，迈步来到赵如安对面坐下，端起茶杯喝了一口，只是心思却早已经不在眼前的茶水身上了。
很快，随着一阵隆隆的马蹄声传来，官道上的尘土都飞扬了起来。
“来了！

The incident happened
As Wu Wei moved into Changdaomen, everyone in Pingchuan City knew that the marriage between Changdaomen and Wuyinting was already a done deal.
On the second day after Wu Wei arrived, some families who were still waiting and watching sent congratulatory gifts to Changdaomen. Even the city lord's palace sent people to send congratulatory letters, which made Zhao Ruan feel more and more satisfied.
Soon, the time came to the day before the wedding. According to the original plan, Elder Li of Wuyinting would come with his two disciples and attend the wedding as an elder.
Early that morning, Zhao Ruan and Wu Wei went to wait outside the city gate. Although there had been reports from Tan Ma that Elder Li and his party would arrive at noon at the earliest, in order to show his sincerity, Zhao Ruan ordered people to prepare for the reception early in the morning. As the eldest disciple, Wu Wei certainly had no objection to this.
In the pavilion outside the city, the smile on Zhao Ruan's face never stopped as waves of scouts came to report.
In two days, their Changdao Clan will become the leading force in Pingchuan City. Zhao Ruan is confident that the name of the Changdao Clan will spread throughout Donghai County within ten years.
"Sect Master, Elder Li and his party have arrived ten miles away.
Another group of scouts came to report, and Zhao Ru'an smiled even more when he heard this.
"My dear nephew, Elder Li moves so quickly, I think he came all the way at a high speed!
"Zhao Ruan looked at Wu Wei on the side and smiled slightly.
When Wu Wei heard this, a flash of doubt flashed in his eyes, as if he was a little confused.
However, when Zhao Ruan was looking at him, Wu Wei still clasped his fists and said, "Twenty sisters are usually the most favored by the master. This time, the master is also very concerned about the wedding of the junior sister. I guess the master is also afraid that something will go wrong, so he rushed over quickly.
"Haha," Zhao Ru'an laughed heartily after hearing this, "
It's better to hurry up. I've already ordered people to prepare some fine wine, just waiting for Elder Li's arrival.
As laughter spread, Zhao Ruan turned around and sat in front of the stone table in the pavilion, took a sip of tea from the table.
"Kang'er," Zhao Ru'an looked at Zhao Kang who was waiting aside, "
You can lead someone for me to greet Elder Li.
Yes, father.
"Zhao Kang heard this and left with fists in his hands.
Wu Wei on the side watched Zhao Kang and his entourage go away. For some reason, he always felt that something was wrong in his heart.
"My dear nephew, come and have tea.
Seeing Wu Wei standing there, Zhao Ruan raised his hand and greeted.
Wu Wei nodded when he heard this, walked over to sit opposite Zhao Ruan, picked up the tea cup and took a sip, but his mind was no longer on the tea in front of him.
Soon, with the rumble of horse hooves, the dust on the official road began to fly.
"Coming!
